paper_title: Dark Matter from Axion Strings with Adaptive Mesh Refinement
coupling_convention: m_a in eV, f_a in GeV
notes: This is a cosmological simulation paper predicting the post-inflation QCD axion DM mass window m_a in (40,180) micro-eV, corresponding to f_a in (3.1e10, 1.4e11) GeV, with a scale-invariant (q=1) prediction of m_a = 65 +/- 6 micro-eV. This is a preferred DM mass range from string network simulations, not an experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection on a coupling. It does not provide an exclusion curve of (mass, coupling) pairs. No extractable limit data points.
